title: Goldreich–Levin stage query program
statement: Let the input consist of a dimension $n>0$, positive accuracy numerator and denominator $a,b$ with $2a\le b$, and an integer Fourier bound $B\ge1$. For $k<n$ and a finite active family of coordinate subsets, the stage program queries the full batch of restricted-weight query points for the prefix $0,\ldots,k$. Once the answers are supplied, it charges the prescribed local computation cost for that stage and returns the corresponding list of estimate records.
hypotheses_covered: finite active family of coordinate subsets
